description: Read a paid draw by paymentId, or a request by requestId, for free. Use it to finish a draw that came back pending or unanswered. Chosen items come back as indices here, not as labels: apply them to the list you sent.

paymentId.description: The paymentId of a paid draw (0x and 64 hex characters).

requestId.description: A request id this API opened, as a decimal string.

name: get_result
title: Read a draw (free)
